originality.rationale: Premature termination and accidentally small adaptive-quadrature differences are already known and explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. Plaskota gives a degree-ten zero-at-all-samples failure. The accepted contribution is the complete degree-six false-zero kernel, exact missed-error functional, minimal-degree boundary, and strictly positive cancellation witness.
